Sava Center is not the organizer of the event.

Entrance to the events is possible only from Vladimira Popovića Street - to the ceremonial entrance of the Blue Hall.

There are works of art without which it is difficult to imagine the holiday season.
"The Nutcracker" by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky is one of the most beloved ballets in the world, a symbol of winter magic, family traditions and the beauty of classical art.

Leading artists of major ballet theaters, guardians of the traditions of the famous Russian ballet school, take part in the performance.
